# Feature flag inventory

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:flags` (scripts/generate-flag-inventory.mjs). Do not edit by hand. -->

[README](../README.md) · [Feature flag guide](feature-flags.md) · [Feature activation](operations/feature-activation.md) · [Manual administration](operations/manual-administration.md#enable-or-disable-a-feature)

Every flag seeded in `server/config/feature-flags.yaml` (130 in total), generated from source. **Seed values are defaults only**: they create missing database rows at startup and never overwrite a live value. Check the live value in Admin → Feature Flags.

- **Seed:** the value a new deployment starts with.
- **Missing row:** what the server does if the database has no row for the flag. **off** means fail-closed (`FAIL_CLOSED_FLAGS` in `entitlementService.ts`, or the Plaid family's own check).
- **Cohort:** Admin can restrict the flag to listed users (`COHORT_FEATURES` in `featureCohorts.ts`).

## Planning, maps and discovery

| Flag | Seed | Missing row | Cohort | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attractions_transfer_directions_api` | on | on |  | Use Google Directions/Distance Matrix API for inter-attraction transfer time instead of the haversine heuristic |
| `getyourguide_activity_suggestions` | on | on |  | Enable optional GetYourGuide affiliate activity suggestions (requires verified partner configuration) |
| `planning_auto_assign` | off | **off** | yes | P2 add confident, matching bookings from the person's own uploads to the right trip automatically, with Undo for 7 days. Default for everyone once on; each person can turn it off. Forwarded email never qualifies. |
| `planning_day_order` | off | **off** | yes | P2 manual drag and move-up/down reordering for a day's activities; optimization additionally requires planning_optimize_order |
| `planning_geocoding` | on | **off** |  | Reviewed public catalog POI lookup via a configured self-hosted/contracted endpoint; no private addresses. Does nothing until the reviewed endpoint/policy config is set; missing row = off |
| `planning_locate_items` | on | **off** |  | Find locations: on a member's explicit request, geocode a lodging, activity or car rental's own saved address with Geoapify (needs GEOAPIFY_API_KEY) and store the result with attribution |
| `planning_native_map` | off | **off** |  | Native MapLibre renderer; requires compatible EAS binary and named-device checks |
| `planning_nearby` | off | **off** | yes | P1 catalog Nearby and atomic Add to day; no external geocoder |
| `planning_notifications` | off | **off** |  | Owner: planning. Durable deadline/digest scheduler; retire after measured rollout. |
| `planning_optimize_order` | off | **off** |  | Show route optimization suggestions and the lodging start/end option; manual reordering remains independently controlled by planning_day_order |
| `planning_structured_import` | off | **off** | yes | P1 bounded calendar and reservation extraction |
| `planning_trip_inspiration` | off | **off** | yes | Destination-matched public trips with explicit catalog activity sharing and credited copies |
| `planning_web_map` | off | **off** | yes | P1 on-device web map; enable after bundle and WebGL checks |
| `trip_bundle` | off | **off** | yes | P1 permission-sensitive conditional trip bundle |
| `trip_day_map` | off | **off** |  | Show a static multi-pin map (flights/lodging/activities/car rentals) on the Overview day-detail view. Off by default until a GOOGLE_STATIC_MAPS_API_KEY / GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is provisioned; see docs/implementation_plans/implementation-plan-trip-day-map.md |
